name: German Bakery Wunderbar
why_it_matters: The Khandala-stretch outpost of the original Pune Koregaon Park German Bakery — opened late 80s; the Khandala property has an open-air pergola + wood-fired pizza oven on the Old Mumbai-Pune Highway opposite Kumar Resort. Continental + European baking with mawa-pastry crossover.
insider_tip: Weekend brunch 9.30-11am fills first — wood-fired pizza arrives by 11.30am. Apple strudel often sells out by 4pm — order with your coffee on arrival. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: NH 4, Old Mumbai-Pune Highway, opposite Kumar Resort, Khandala 410301

name: Hotel Krishna
why_it_matters: Khandala bus-stand Maharashtrian-thali workhorse for 50 years — Khopoli-Khandala-Lonavala bus-route stop. Pithla-bhakri (chickpea-flour curry + jowar bread) is the rare Sahyadri-village order few tourist restaurants do well; the unlimited Maharashtrian thali at ₹220 covers the basics.
insider_tip: Lunch starts 11.30am; full by 1.30pm Sat-Sun. Cash + UPI only; cards iffy. Ask for 'tikha' (extra spice) — the kitchen tones it down for tourists by default.

name: Hotel Rama Krishna
why_it_matters: Khandala main-road family restaurant — Konkani + Maharashtrian + South-Indian cross-menu serving the Mumbai-Pune highway crowd. Fish thali (surmai/bombil/pomfret based on Mumbai-jetty supply) is the meat option; the pure-veg Maharashtrian thali is the daily-driver. Slightly more polished than the bus-stand kitchens.
insider_tip: Fish thali in the 1-2pm slot only — supply runs out fast. Idli-sambar breakfast 7-10am is the cheapest stop on the Khandala main road. Cash + UPI.

name: Squirrel Restaurant (Khandala Hill Resort)
signature_dish: Maharashtrian thali on the ridge terrace
why_it_matters: Squirrel Hill Resort's in-house restaurant on the Khandala ridge — multi-cuisine but the Maharashtrian-thali rotation is the day's honest order. Open-side dining with monsoon-cloud view directly over the Khopoli valley Jul-Sep. Hotel-tied but accepts walk-in lunch from non-residents.
insider_tip: Monsoon (Jul-Sep) lunch on the outdoor terrace is the seasonal pull — book +91-2114-273788. Weekday walk-ins are easy; Sat-Sun book ahead. Cards + UPI.
